### script-injection (severity: high)

Rule (a) is violated: an expression is placed directly in the run: script of the 'Gather the metadata' step. Offending lines: `if [[ -n "${{ inputs.venv }}" ]]; then` and `source "${{ inputs.venv }}"`. Fix: map it through env (e.g. VENV: ${{ inputs.venv }}) and use "$VENV" in the script.
